scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the expected k1, k2, and r at both temperatures from the paper's equations using the given parameters, then compares the agent's reported numbers against the recomputed reference within tolerance.

k1_highT.description: Induced anisotropy constant k1 at T=0.9*Tc

k2_highT.description: Induced anisotropy constant k2 at T=0.9*Tc

r_highT.description: Long-range order parameter r at T=0.9*Tc

k1_lowT.description: Induced anisotropy constant k1 at T=0.4*Tc

k2_lowT.description: Induced anisotropy constant k2 at T=0.4*Tc

r_lowT.description: Long-range order parameter r at T=0.4*Tc

outputs.description: Contains the computed induced anisotropy constants k1, k2 and the long-range order parameter r at the two specified reduced temperatures, computed from the linearized quasi-chemical solution with V=1, k=1, L=0.1, field direction [100].

output_contract.notes: The zeroth-order solution (process step) is required to compute the scored quantities; no paper-specific gold values or tolerances are exposed.

steps.description: Compare k1, k2, r at high and low temperature to the recomputed reference values.
